Subject: Post-demo: Aurora inference pilot — next steps

Hi Asha / Tom,

Thanks again for your time today — great discussion and appreciated the detail on your inference latency and throughput targets. Quick recap + suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap from the call:
  • Target production latency: 60ms P95 on 4k context for customer-facing features
  • Expected steady-state qps: ~150 requests/sec for 1M monthly active users
  • Data sensitivity: PHI subset for 10% of calls (we discussed VPC & KMS options)

- Proposed pilot scope (2–4 week):
  1) Ingest sample dataset (anonymized) + run throughput profile on Dedicated pool
  2) Validate latency at 4k context; capture token-level cost estimates
  3) Turn on prefix caching for common flows and measure improvements

- Next steps I can take:
  • Share a Mutual Action Plan (attached) with dates and owners
  • Draft a short SOW for legal/procurement to review (attached)
  • Provision a sandbox instance for your team to smoke test (needs a small sample dataset + network IP allowlist)

Could you confirm: (A) whether procurement needs an internal SOW before a pilot, (B) who on your side will provision the sample data, and (C) an ideal start window (Apr 5–12 or Apr 19–23)?

Attachments: Aurora_MutualActionPlan.xlsx, SOW-draft-v1.pdf

If it helps, I can block 30 minutes next week to walk through the action plan with your procurement and infra leads.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Wanted to close the loop on this thread. I haven’t seen a confirmation on timing or the SOW request; totally understand how busy things get. Quick ask: if this is no longer a near-term priority, would you prefer I step back and deprioritize the Aurora pilot in our pipeline for Q2?
